events.verdict: Conley (MIN) and Gillespie (PHX) briefly engage and disengage off of the ball.
Randle (MIN) places and immediately removes his right hand from Allen's (PHX) front during his drive and the contact is marginal.
Goodwin (PHX) places both hands on Conley (MIN) as he sets the pick, but the contact is marginal.

Reid (MIN) secures the loose ball and the ensuing contact with Goodwin (PHX) is incidental. Goodwin and Williams (PHX) each briefly get their hand on the ball, but the timeout by Minnesota is recognized when Reid is in sole possession of the ball.
Reid (MIN) loses his balance on his own accord, and not as a result of any illegal contact by Brooks (PHX).
Williams (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position during Randle's (MIN) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) legally contests Brooks' (PHX) jump shot attempt.
O'Neale (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position during Randle's (MIN) drive to the basket.
Randle (MIN) grabs and holds Allen's (PHX) arm during the rebound.
Hyland (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position during Gillespie's (PHX) drive toward the basket and jump shot attempt.
Reid (MIN) and Williams (PHX) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Edwards (MIN) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps before passing.
Brooks (PHX) reaches in and any contact that occurs with Edwards (MIN) during his drive to the basket is marginal.
DiVincenzo (MIN) loses his balance and the ensuing contact with Gillespie (PHX) is marginal.
McDaniels (MIN) commits a take foul on Gillespie (PHX).
Gillespie (PHX) legally contests McDaniels' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
